allocation: initial position budget = signal NAV / N; at most N holdings; no forced full investment or additional purchases
entry: new entries from top N; other universe and selection-cycle rules unchanged
exit: same MA60, 15% trailing stop and retain-through-rank20 rule for all N
costs: same zero commission/slippage and dated sale taxes as base research
objectives: mean,95th-percentile and maximum daily order attempts
days requiring an order and fills
comparison: same input/windows; use common observed prefix when data censor; report observed session count; no winner selection from short incomplete periods
decisionPolicy: Seek a stable return/drawdown/workload tradeoff across sequential periods, not the single highest retrospective return. Prefer fewer holdings only when performance/risk are close under criteria fixed before final selection. No user workload cap or acceptable performance difference has yet been fixed.
caveats: Sizes chosen after earlier M1/M2 research was viewed; retrospective not untouched validation
Daily order counts are workload proxies, not measured user time
3-stock allocation can concentrate roughly one third of NAV in a new holding; concentration risk must be compared
Do not exclude future corporate-event names retrospectively to complete performance
